purpose: One committed HTTP/SSE wire-conformance example (E5): the exact terminal frame sequence fin emits for a mixed valid run plus one mid-stream named refusal, consumable by #322 without copying an independently defined schema. The frame data is the projection of the payload's input_citations through fin.host.workspace_http._citations_wire_projection, pinned live by tests/host/test_workspace_http.py so the example cannot drift from the emitter.

notes.evidence_schema: carried once on the status (terminal) frame and the response envelopes; the citations frame data stays the plain array of frozen rows (plan E5 carrier rule).
notes.citations_frame: document rows byte-identical to the stored shape; a ledger row's snapshot gains the fin.evidence.database_row_snapshot token minted on the emission only (stored v0 rows are never rewritten).
notes.evidence_refusals_frame: new event vocabulary; entry shape mirrors the history read's rejected_citations (citation_index + section 6 code); today's web reader skips unknown events until E6 decodes this one.
notes.order: status -> answer -> evidence_refusals (only when a row is refused) -> citations; the citations frame closes the reader, so refusals ride BEFORE it.
